prompt: Spring Boot Undertow access log %D response time prerequisite
answer:
Set:

```properties
server.undertow.options.server.record-request-start-time=true
```

This enables Undertow to record the request start time, which is required for the `%D` access-log response-time value. `%D` represents processing time in milliseconds.
